summary: Blue Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K announcing a Third Amendment to its Business Combination Agreement with Blockfusion Digital Infrastructure, Inc. (Pubco) and related parties. The amendment adds an earnout provision for up to 9,250,000 Pubco Class A common shares to certain Blockfusion stockholders based on stock price thresholds over 36 months post-close, and reduces the post-closing board from 9 to 7 members. No advisor or recommendation is named. The transaction is a de-SPAC merger; Blue will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Pubco. Watch for shareholder vote and redemptions; the earnout creates a risk-arb angle tied to post-merger stock performance.
